svg.aria-label: The draft mode of the grant skill. Boxes: Intake agent: the questions of the grant intake (agent); You answer the intake (stop); Structure architect: the outline, in the funder's sections (agent); You confirm the outline (stop); Argument builder: each section's argument for the criteria (agent); Draft writer: the application's .tex, or a patch of a section (agent); Citation compliance: each cited claim, only with a .bib (agent, only when needed); Formatter: the layout of the funder config, only when it states one (agent, only when needed); Draft writer, resumed: content cut once, when the compile is over the page limit (agent, only when needed); You pick the writing findings to apply (stop); Draft writer, resumed: the picked findings as one patch (agent, only when needed).

svg.text: names none, and passes on a stop of the paper skill. A draft of a form field starts the intake

svg.text: agent and the draft writer only, which writes the field's text into grant-fields.md. The config

svg.text: mode starts the config drafter and shows you its draft to confirm; for a file of form-field texts

svg.text: when the file is in another format, and shows you the form fields to confirm. The revise mode

svg.text: starts the draft writer on a comments file and ends with the same cut and the same writing review.

svg.text: criterion and changes nothing. The check mode starts no agent: it compiles and runs the two
